title: Bind the selected gen4 certificate to fresh replay outputs
body:
`gen4-bank-verify` checks the selected record against its frozen certificate and runs a fresh supplier replay, but does not compare that replay's certificate with the frozen publication. This adds the missing comparison after a successful replay and makes the dedicated workflow use the same Make target.

The helper compares the complete current certificate recursively, preserving JSON types, field sets and array order while accepting equivalent exact rational strings. It binds the frozen bytes to the selected digest, the fresh positive kappa to the selected values, and the receipt to the source manifest, file count and all nine stages. Only the receipt's nonnegative finite timings may vary. Make stops on temporary-directory, supplier or binding failure; workflow path filters cover the relevant inputs and tests.

Validation of this exact four-file patch:

- Independent bounded review: 1,894 cases passed (1,747 expected rejections and 147 acceptances), including separate changes to every one of the 177 certificate leaves in fresh and frozen outputs, and five Make scenarios using command stubs.
- All 14 authored tests passed independently and again in a clean worktree on Python 3.14.8: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_selected_replay.py' -v`.
- The patch applies cleanly to main at `12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b`; reconstructed files match the independently reviewed bytes.

**Still unverified:** the full source-bound supplier replay, actual `make gen4-bank-verify`, Python 3.11/3.13 CI and global `make verify`. The historical joint-dual manifest already pins a different Makefile hash on the base; this separate compatibility issue is not repaired here. The Python matrix, dependency/action pins, regeneration step and clean-tree check are retained.

This checks consistency after a trusted replay. It does not authenticate a standalone receipt, establish execution by itself or prove the shared certificate's mathematics. No certificate, selected value, source manifest or theorem changes. A bounded check of current PR descriptions and related Make/checker variants found no duplicate of this selected-gen4 binding; no exclusivity claim is made.

This builds on the existing selected-result checker and reviewed gen4 supplier, retaining their contributor attribution. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
